name: Unusual
long_description:
AI agents are the newest audience brands need to speak to, but go-to-market teams don't have the tools to understand how they form opinions or make decisions.

Unusual helps brands in the Fortune 100 and scale-ups like Change.org and Astronomer drive more sales and win more market share by shifting how AI models perceive their offerings.

We work closely with every brand to (1) identify the root cause of AI misperception, (2) align on marketing, sales, and product strategies that appeal to agents, and (3) build infrastructure and content that makes their strongest proof more legible to agents.

Our methodology centers on applying black-box interpretability techniques to AI agents like ChatGPT and Claude to understand how they form opinions about a brand and its competitors. Seeing the *why* behind each opinion gives us the ability to create targeted interventions that change them.

launches.title: Unusual – AI Relations
launches.tagline: Get more leads with PR campaigns targeted at ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, and more
launches.body:
Unusual creates and suggests media engineered to improve how AI talks about your brand – driving you more leads. This is the first “AI Relations” tool – public relations for AI models.

**The problem:**

Every day, your customers rely more on ChatGPT for their buying decisions. 

Getting tools like ChatGPT to send you leads is a lot more than GEO/AEO; it’s more like running a PR campaign – strategically building credibility and authority with models themselves.

**The solution:**

We built a platform that helps you improve AI’s holistic picture of your brand – what we’re calling “AI Relations.”

https://youtu.be/EIkyCu3kTt4 

We break this into three components, all of which Unusual manages:

1. Filling key knowledge gaps – publishing LLM-optimized content full of information LLMs are searching for, but don’t have: like a reference manual for your company. Check out ours here: https://llms.unusual.ai  
2. Getting you on the map – flagging the 3rd party media sources LLMs look to in your industry.
3. Nuanced reporting – analyzing how LLMs think about your company, and giving you extremely detailed reports on why they make the recommendations they do.

Unusual also track AI crawls of your content, so you can measure when it’s getting picked up and referenced by LLMs, helping you track ROI.

**Results:**

Quality wins fast with AI systems – content with rich and needed information is quickly picked up and referenced.

For [Parley](https://parley.so), an early customer, Unusual identified a key gap in what Perplexity knew about the space of SOC2 compliant AI for law firms. It automatically published pages to fill the gaps ([Model Use, Data Flows, and Isolation by Firm](https://ai.parley.so/model-use-data-flows-firm-isolation), [Encryption, Access Controls, and Audit Logging](https://ai.parley.so/encryption-access-controls-audit-logging)) and within a month, those two pages were within the top 3 most important citations for the topic area.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=94065&key=user_uploads/317891/2da445ae-819c-4443-b491-c094c14c1fe4)

launches.body:
**TLDR:** Unusual personalizes your website for every visitor. Customers have boosted their leads by 4x from SEO/blogs, ads, 3rd party links, and even Linkedin outreach to individual prospects.

**SEE FOR YOURSELF**

Our website _normally_ looks like this: 

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=87418&key=user_uploads/317891/c5f7735d-81e5-45ce-9571-756857e97a7b)

**Now, click on** [**unusual.ai**](https://unusual.ai) 👀 … you can see how it adapts to you coming from [YCombinator.com](http://YCombinator.com).

<https://youtu.be/RQ0j7OCAjmE>

Unusual uses information about the visitor to tailor the copy on your website automatically. Just drop a script in your site, and you're good to go!

**Automatic personalization from any source of traffic**

* Unusual can serve a unique version of your site for every single ad, blog post, social media post, email and more. 
* If you highlight a particular feature of your product in a blog post, that feature will be prominently displayed on the page the users see.

**Personalize your outbound sales**

* Include a custom version of your site in emails to prospects.
* Depending on who they are, their position at the company, the industry, etc…

**Create one-off versions of your site in seconds**

* Create new landing pages with a prompt

**Create custom sites via API**

* All of Unusual’s personalization features are available via API, so you can programmatically create variants of your website (think attaching a custom page to LinkedIn or Email outreach)

**Want to try it out?**

* It’s a two line of code integration, it works with every kind of website, and we’re happy to help you get set up.

launches.body:
**TL;DR** Aditto lets you run search engine marketing without marketers. Every day, Aditto generates new search ads and custom landing pages based on search trends, and lets you launch them with the click of a button. Our first customer: 2x leads, ½ cost per conversion in week one.

<https://www.loom.com/share/e7084374372343b18af1972bde1e694b?sid=9b5e4dfa-9340-4ef8-9994-af51523b0ae0>

---

### **The problem**

Search ads are a huge pain to set up and manage – and when founders hire marketers to do it for them, they often misunderstand their product and market and waste money on bad leads.

Running effective ad campaigns means either:

1. Wasting precious time learning the "dark arts" of ad platforms
2. Bleeding money on experiments while competing against marketing veterans
3. Burning 10-30% of your ad budget on marketers who barely understand your product

---

### **Our insights**

* Founders are the best marketers but lack the tools/know-how.
* Marketers don’t understand your product, but they know a lot about the “dark arts” of running Google ads and landing page optimization.

---

### **The solution**

Aditto puts founders in the driver’s seat while automating the grunt work. Our first customer 2x’d their leads while halving CPA in the first week with Aditto.

Just sign up for Google Ads, drop a script tag into your site, and you’re good to go.
